title: Kiln Read-only Serving and Observability API v1
description: Closed field-level wire contract for health, resolved configuration, model-state debug, model discovery, decode statistics, recent requests, and persistent logit-cache statistics.

AcceleratorWeightUploadConfigResponse.description: Resolved startup-only accelerator-weight upload policy and completed real-model observation.

AcceleratorWeightUploadReport.description: Exact completed source-byte, layer, elapsed-time, and pacing accounting for eager base-model accelerator upload.

ActiveJobInfo.description: The active training job and its reported progress.

ActorCycleIdleDiagnostics.description: Configured cooperative safe-boundary actor idle and control-command polling contract.

AdapterDebugState.description: Active, loaded, discoverable, and failed adapter state.

BackendRuntimeInfo.description: Backend health, quarantine, restart, and external-yield settlement state.

BaseWeightShardIdentity.description: Exact identity of one logical safetensors shard.

BaseWeightShardManifest.description: Canonical portable manifest for the exact loaded base-weight shards.

BatchedStateCacheStats.description: Current ownership and process-lifetime lifecycle counters for the parked batched recurrent-state cache.

BatchingConfigResponse.description: Resolved batching policy plus live actor and fallback-route state.

BatchingEffectiveSource.description: The authority that selected an effective batching value.

BatchingEngineDebugState.description: Selected batching backend, resolved configuration, and live execution state.

BatchingEngineSnapshot.description: Cached batching-engine admission, execution, latency, backpressure, and fairness counters.

BatchingMode.description: Operator intent for production batching-actor ownership.

BatchingRuntimeConfig.description: Runtime-ready batching policy resolved once after backend selection.

BatchingToggleDiagnostics.description: A resolved batching toggle and its startup provenance.

CacheDebugState.description: Deterministic response, prompt, token, prefix-cache, and backend recurrent-state ownership.

CacheStats.description: Persistent logit-cache occupancy keyed by authoritative teacher revision.

CacheStatsResponse.description: Persistent logit-cache root and occupancy report.

CheckpointBoundaryPolicy.description: Resolved checkpoint-boundary retention and sparse replay policy.

CheckpointBoundaryRecomputeMode.description: Checkpoint-boundary retention or sparse replay mode.

CheckpointReadConfigResponse.description: Resolved startup-only checkpoint-read policy and completed real-model observations.

CheckpointReadPhaseReport.description: Completed logical/read-byte, elapsed-time, and pacing accounting for one checkpoint-read phase.

CheckpointReadReport.description: Exact completed accounting for all loader-owned checkpoint-read phases.

ConfigHashes.description: Available hashes of loaded model, tokenizer, template, and effective environment configuration.

ConfigResponse.description: Complete resolved configuration and live capacity response.

ConfigValueSource.description: The startup authority that supplied a resolved configuration value.

CudaFlashBackwardMode.description: The process-lifetime CUDA FlashAttention backward accumulation mode.

CudaGraphConfigResponse.description: Startup-resolved CUDA graph request, cache bound, and fixed safety invariants.

CudaGraphInfo.description: Configured CUDA graph request, live runner state, bounded cache, and fixed safety invariants.

CudaKernelProfile.description: The process-lifetime CUDA backend-kernel route set.

CudaMarlinProfile.description: The process-lifetime CUDA Marlin projection layout.

DebugDisabledResponse.description: HTTP 403 body returned when model-state diagnostics are not enabled.

DebugProvenanceErrorResponse.description: HTTP 500 body returned when the resident execution provenance fails validation.

DecodeBatchEffectiveSource.description: The authority that selected the effective concurrent decode width.

DecodeBatcherStats.description: Legacy decode-batcher activity and runner-call budget counters.

DecodeRuntimeInfo.description: Resolved decode configuration and live backend execution state.

DecodeStatsSnapshot.description: Rolling request-local decode throughput, ITL tail, and bounded stall diagnosis.

DeterministicInferenceDiagnostics.description: Resolved deterministic-inference state and startup provenance.

DirectDecodeRendezvousDiagnostics.description: Resolved fallback direct-stream greedy decode rendezvous policy.

DirectDecodeRendezvousRuntimeState.description: Runtime availability of the fallback direct-streaming greedy rendezvous.

DirectDecodeRendezvousValueDiagnosticsBo.description: Configured, backend, and effective direct-decode rendezvous value.

DirectDecodeRendezvousValueDiagnosticsIn.description: Configured, backend, and effective direct-decode rendezvous value.

EffectiveConfiguration.description: The deterministic flat map of every typed startup leaf after precedence, plus dynamic teacher-credential leaves.

EffectiveConfigurationField.description: One post-precedence typed startup value, its authority, environment spellings, redaction state, and lifecycle.

ExecutionConfigurationIdentity.description: Effective server configuration and environment identity.

ExecutionModelIdentity.description: Loaded model, tokenizer, and template identity.

ExecutionPrecisionIdentity.description: Resolved inference and training precision identity.

ExecutionProvenanceV1.description: Immutable self-verifying execution envelope captured at server startup.

ExternalYieldSyncStats.description: Process-lifetime settlement counters at one external-yield boundary.

FiniteNumber.description: A finite Rust floating-point value. serde_json rejects non-finite values.

GenerationConfig.description: Resolved server-wide thinking and reasoning-content defaults.

GpuMemoryInfo.description: Startup GPU memory budget plus the live all-process memory observation.

GradientCheckpointPolicy.description: Tagged immutable gradient-checkpoint behavior for one native training run.

GraphInfo.description: Nonblocking CUDA or Metal graph state.

HealthCheck.description: One stable readiness condition and its result.

HealthResponse.description: Complete readiness and runtime diagnostic response returned with HTTP 200 or 503.

HttpRuntimeInfo.description: Resolved and kernel-readback HTTP socket send-buffer state.

KtApiMode.description: The process-lifetime kiln-tensor adapter route selection.

KvAutoscalerState.description: Startup and activation state for the physical KV-cache autoscaler.

LastErrorSummary.description: Compact summary of the most recent failed or timed-out request.

LatencyPhaseTimings.description: Bounded request phase timings; null means the serving path did not measure that subphase.

LatencyStallReasonCounts.description: Fixed-cardinality token-stall counts by dominant blocking reason.

MetalKernelProfile.description: The process-lifetime Metal backend-kernel route set.

ModelDebugState.description: Loaded model shape, provenance, defaults, and backend health state.

ModelStateResponse.description: Complete opt-in model, adapter, provenance, typed runtime, and cache debug state.
